name: fl_diagnostic_tracer
description: Empirical red-loop diagnostic engine. Validates deterministic test reproduction commands (failing before fix), manages non-invasive [DEBUG-xxxx] log probe injection, and provides zero-residue atomic probe cleanup across target files.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'verify_repro' (runs command to assert failing/red status), 'inject_probe' (inserts tagged DEBUG probe), 'clean_probes' (removes all [DEBUG-xxxx] probes from file or directory), or 'list_probes'.

command.description: Command string to run for reproduction testing (required for 'verify_repro').

cwd.description: Working directory for command execution. Defaults to current directory ('.').

target_path.description: Target file or directory path for probe injection or cleanup.

probe_code.description: Code snippet or expression to evaluate inside probe (e.g. 'console.log("val:", x);').

probe_tag.description: Custom probe tag suffix (defaults to auto-generated hex id).

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
